domain_entities.name: LeaveRequest
domain_entities.purpose: Represents an employee's request for leave. Central entity of the leave management module. Tracks the full lifecycle from draft through submission, approval/rejection, and optional cancellation.
lifecycle_states: DRAFT: Initial state when an employee begins creating a leave request. Editable by the employee. No balance is reserved.
SUBMITTED: Employee has submitted the request for manager review. Balance is tentatively reserved. Employee cannot edit; only manager can act.
APPROVED: Manager has approved the request. Balance is permanently deducted. Employee may still cancel (withdraw) the approved leave.
REJECTED: Manager has rejected the request. Tentative balance reservation is released. Terminal state — no further transitions.
CANCELLED: The request has been cancelled, either by the employee (from DRAFT, SUBMITTED, or APPROVED) or by the system. Any reserved or deducted balance is released/restored. Terminal state.

domain_entities.name: LeavePolicy
domain_entities.purpose: Defines the rules and entitlements for a specific category of leave. Each policy governs how many days an employee is entitled to, whether manager approval is required, minimum notice periods, and accrual behaviour.
lifecycle_states: ACTIVE: Policy is in effect and governs leave requests. Employees can request leave under this policy.
INACTIVE: Policy has been disabled. No new leave requests can be created under this policy. Existing approved requests are unaffected.
ARCHIVED: Policy is retired. Retained for historical/audit purposes only. No requests can reference it.

domain_entities.name: LeaveBalance
domain_entities.purpose: Tracks an employee's leave entitlement, usage, and remaining balance for a specific policy and fiscal year. The pendingDays field tracks days reserved by submitted-but-not-yet-decided requests.
lifecycle_states: ACTIVE: Balance is in effect for the current fiscal year. Used for entitlement checks and deductions.
EXHAUSTED: remainingDays has reached zero. No further leave of this type can be taken until the next fiscal year or accrual replenishes it.
FROZEN: Balance is temporarily suspended (e.g., employee on long-term leave, investigation). No deductions or requests allowed.
CLOSED: Fiscal year has ended. Balance is archived and a new balance record is created for the next fiscal year.

domain_entities.name: Employee
domain_entities.purpose: Represents an employee in the organisation. The employee is the actor who requests leave and the subject whose balances are tracked. The managerId links to the approving manager.
lifecycle_states: ACTIVE: Employee is currently employed and eligible to request leave.
INACTIVE: Employee is on extended leave or suspension. Leave requests are blocked.
TERMINATED: Employment has ended. All balances are closed. No new requests allowed.

domain_entities.name: LeaveType
attributes: ANNUAL: Annual leave — planned time off, typically accrued over the year
SICK: Sick leave — unplanned absence due to illness or injury
EMERGENCY: Emergency leave — urgent, unforeseen personal circumstances
UNPAID: Unpaid leave — leave without pay beyond entitled balances
domain_entities.purpose: Enumeration of leave categories. Each LeaveType maps to a LeavePolicy that defines the rules for that category. Determines balance tracking, approval requirements, and whether the leave is paid or unpaid.

business_rules: BR-001 — Balance Sufficiency: A LeaveRequest may only transition from DRAFT to SUBMITTED if the employee's LeaveBalance for the corresponding policy and fiscal year has sufficient remainingDays (remainingDays - pendingDays >= requested working days). If the balance is EXHAUSTED or FROZEN, submission must be rejected.

BR-002 — Manager Approval: A LeaveRequest in SUBMITTED state may only transition to APPROVED or REJECTED by the employee's manager (employee.managerId). The approving/rejecting actor must match the managerId of the requesting employee. Self-approval is prohibited.

BR-004 — Minimum Notice: When a LeavePolicy defines minimumNoticeDays > 0, a LeaveRequest may only transition from DRAFT to SUBMITTED if (startDate - today) >= minimumNoticeDays in calendar days. Emergency leave (LeaveType.EMERGENCY) is exempt from this rule.

BR-005 — Date Validity: A LeaveRequest must satisfy startDate <= endDate. startDate must not be in the past at the time of submission (DRAFT → SUBMITTED). Both dates must fall within the same fiscal year as the balance being drawn from.
BR-006 — Active Employee Only: Only employees with employmentStatus = ACTIVE may create or submit LeaveRequests. INACTIVE and TERMINATED employees are blocked from all leave operations.
BR-007 — Active Policy Only: A LeaveRequest may only reference a LeavePolicy whose isActive is true. INACTIVE and ARCHIVED policies cannot be used for new requests.

BR-008 — Balance Reservation on Submit: When a LeaveRequest transitions from DRAFT to SUBMITTED, the corresponding LeaveBalance.pendingDays is incremented by the number of working days in the request. This prevents double-booking of the same entitlement.
